_doc: Example content pack: one item, one life event, one bottle note, one radio line.

tide_charm.name: Tide charm
tide_charm.desc: A knot of blue thread and a fish bone. The Vigil sells them to the nervous.

events.title: A charm
events.text: A Vigil novice offers you a tide charm for a single scrap.

out.text: You tie it to your wrist next to your band. You feel exactly as lucky as before, which is fine.
The novice smiles. 'The tide is patient.'

bottles: This bottle came from a content pack. Hello from outside the water.

freevoice.text: A message from the mod deck: the Drift is bigger than the map.
